catalogue_scope_and_required_fields.finding: All 2,203 catalogue records have non-empty record identity and URL, at least one source URL, explicit access state, rights state and primary rights reference, non-empty caveat IDs and evidence references. There are zero duplicate record IDs, zero duplicate canonical record URLs and zero source-family labels indicating property/title records, transaction rows, forum content or uploads. The 17 source families close exactly across the inventory, domain profile and source register.

rights_layer_separation.finding: All catalogue records resolve to one of nine applicable primary rights references governed by the ten-assessment rights ledger; RIGHT-EVIDENCE governs project receipts rather than a catalogue source record. OGL-with-exceptions, dataset-specific terms, restricted services, repository metadata, catalogue discovery metadata, legislation, cross-government catalogues, fee-calculator operation, project evidence and prohibited personal content remain distinct. Public reachability, zero price and neighbouring OGL furniture are never treated as permission for anonymous operation or open redistribution.

curated_classification_boundary.finding: The curated rights/access input declares and contains exactly 55 record-level classifications. Each row limits its evidence URL to public metadata, documentation or an authority route and explicitly states that reachability does not make a linked service, dataset, output or attachment public, free or openly licensed. Remaining records inherit only governed source-family defaults or exact override rules; focused tamper regressions passed.

restricted_services_and_access_boundarie.finding: Twenty-one records use RIGHT-RESTRICTED: 20 are restricted-service rows and the Local Land Charges terms page is deliberately metadata-only despite its public access. Their access states are 16 approved-professional-users, three authenticated, one documentation-public-service-restricted and one public terms page. Business Gateway rows require approval and certificates and carry explicit no-authentication, no-call, no-search, no-monitoring and no-automation caveats. Property Alert, property search and Local Land Charges retain RIGHT-PERSONAL as an additional independent constraint. The bundle contains public descriptions and routes only, never evidence of service execution.

privacy_and_prohibited_content.finding: The acquisition and product contracts prohibit live property results, title and ownership records, charge/application/search results, forum posts, uploads, user queries and personal contact data. The generated source-family distribution contains no property-level acquisition lane. The only primary RIGHT-PERSONAL record is the top-level customer-help route and explicitly excludes posts, profiles and uploads; three restricted service records carry RIGHT-PERSONAL additionally. Targeted scans found zero e-mail-address or UK-postcode patterns in catalogue titles, descriptions and caveats. Form identifiers, API templates, legislation numbers and repository names are treated as source metadata rather than personal property records.

credentials_secrets_and_urls.finding: All 6,686 catalogue URL values (2,243 unique) use HTTPS. Independent checks found zero userinfo credentials, literal whitespace, quotes, malformed percent escapes, unsafe delimiters, explicit ports or credential-bearing query keys. Across 111,456 canonical assertion authority/evidence/rights URL occurrences (2,272 unique), every value is HTTP(S) and the same unsafe and credential patterns are absent. Uncompressed bundle and decompressed runtime scans found no private-key header, AWS access-key form, GitHub token form, bearer-token form or sensitive credential query value. Public WSDL and percent-encoded endpoint templates remain metadata and are explicitly restricted, not credentials or authorisation.

semantic_evidence_rights.finding: Every one of the 22,267 reified semantic assertions has a derived authority object, an assertion-rights object and one to four evidence bindings, totalling 33,461 evidence rows. All 22,267 assertions are normalised, real-world scoped and in the core asserted plane with review status implementation-authorised-pending-release-review. Evidence resources, authority sources and rights sources are credential-free web URLs. The canonical JSON-LD/YAML-LD retain the complete evidence envelope; the bounded runtime projection cannot upgrade derived authority, rights or confidence.

rights_and_risk_release_boundary.finding: The governed rights review permits candidate generation only, records release_approved false and discloses that no human legal or licence audit is complete. RISK-001 through RISK-018 remain explicit, including legal reliance, exact-boundary, mixed-rights, privacy, credential, volatility, accessibility, AI-assurance and unsigned-identity risks. This review finds the candidate controls coherent; it does not accept residual risk or convert open and accepted-gap entries into closure.

unsafe_claims.finding: The candidate does not settle ownership or priority, identify an exact legal boundary, provide legal advice, promise current fees or migration state, claim complete public-estate coverage, flatten mixed rights to OGL, claim HM Land Registry endorsement, claim CPSV-AP SHACL conformance or inference, or claim that AI-assisted accessibility checks establish WCAG conformance. Source-native repository descriptions are retained as metadata and do not become bundle-level product claims.

evaluator_delta_rights_impact.finding: The correction after candidate 0097353 changes only the evaluator, its regression tests, release-assurance wording, the evaluator entry in the build receipt and the resulting checksum/release root. Every rights, source, catalogue and semantic graph byte is identical to the superseded candidate. The new tree verifier additionally fails closed on symlinks, non-regular entries and unsafe relative paths; no access or rights boundary is weakened.
